requirement.normalizedRequirement: non_magnetic_heading_means_count >= 2; the two means shall be independent and each shall be connected to main_power and emergency_power.
requirement.requiredInputs: Heading-equipment inventory, independence relation, and power connections
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Ships shall have two non-magnetic means to determine and display their heading. Both means shall be independent and shall be connected to the ship's main and emergency source of power.
